instruction: I don't want Thunderbird to automatically save drafts of my emails while I'm composing them. Please disable the automatic draft saving feature.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic draft saving (mail.compose.autosave=false). Evaluator checks if the preference is set to false. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) containing all settings including auto-save preference
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs properly parses prefs.js file using regex and JSON parsing to extract key-value pairs
Expected value mail.compose.autosave=false is semantically correct - this is the actual Thunderbird preference that controls automatic draft saving
Complete coverage - instruction has single requirement (disable auto-save) and evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Data flow is correct: task completion -> close app -> extract prefs file -> parse and check preference -> return score
Metric handles edge cases properly (None file returns 0.0, malformed lines skipped, both expect/unexpect rules supported)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
